Fidessa Corporation seeks a Developer to build, test, deploy, and maintain software applications. The role focuses on C++ development on UNIX-based platforms, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and improving software performance and reliability.

Responsibilities
Utilize in-depth knowledge of computer systems engineering and data structures to design software, write technical documentation, define software test plans, and plan and execute reasonable timelines for software development projects
Responsible for developing high-quality software that is accurate and efficient, primarily using C++ on UNIX-based platforms
Gathering business requirements and translating them into technical specifications. Design, develop, test, and deploy software applications
Responsible for writing test notes and documentation in support of software development and running unit and integration tests of internal software
Monitor the performance of Fidessa software components and provide recommendations for system improvements, as well as develop and test application revisions as necessary. Responsible for system maintenance, including identifying, troubleshooting, debugging, and remediating software malfunctions and other issues with our complex software
Identify opportunities and recommend changes regarding software system development and maintenance standards
Provide expertise in software development to internal teams with the goal of designing and implementing software components that meet complex business and technical objectives
